President Trump’s 2025 threats to “take it back” from alleged Chinese influence prompted Pentagon planning options and visits by Secretaries Rubio and Hegseth, leading to a security agreement for US troop rotations, Panama’s exit from China’s Belt and Road Initiative, and a Panamanian court ruling that transferred two key ports from a Hong Kong operator to a BlackRock-led group.
